mechanism: Ibuprofen may increase haloperidol plasma concentrations through CYP3A4/CYP2D6 inhibition and potentially increase neuroleptic side effects; NSAIDs also increase risk of extrapyramidal symptoms and reduce renal clearance of haloperidol.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects including extrapyramidal symptoms, use alternative analgesics (acetaminophen, topical NSAIDs) when possible, and ensure adequate hydration to maintain renal function.
